description: This file defines a class LazyOpenStream that implements lazy opening of a stream in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library. It defers opening a file until an IO operation is performed.

classes.name: LazyOpenStream
classes.description: A class that lazily opens a file stream only when needed, implementing the StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filename and mode, deferring the stream opening.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the underlying stream lazily when required by opening the file with the specified mode.
